text.tspan: Always: helper2 and helper2-backoffice Deployments (RollingUpdate maxSurge 1, maxUnavailable 0,
spread by hostname), postgres and redis StatefulSets (one replica, RWO volume;
postgres: startup probe up to 10 min, then liveness; redis: liveness after 30 s),
ServiceAccount helper2 without token, ingress-postgres, ingress-redis
new pods ready one at a time
missed if it cannot start within an hour;
rclone copy to R2 after the dump;
